title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
note: MEAT (Monitor, Evaluate, Assess/Address, Treat) is an industry mnemonic, not CMS wording. The underlying rule is coding conditions that coexist and affect care at the encounter.

missed_supported_condition.description: Did not code a chronic condition the provider monitored, evaluated, assessed or treated.

coded_without_meat.description: Coded a condition that only appears in a problem list or history without being addressed.

coded_from_med_list.description: Inferred and coded a diagnosis from a medication list.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used an unspecified code when severity/type was documented.

rules.explain: The provider addressed COPD at this visit (status and plan documented), so it is supported and coded.

wrong.why: Status plus a plan in the assessment supports the diagnosis.

rules.explain: The provider addressed chronic systolic heart failure at this visit, so it is supported: I50.22.

wrong.why: Status plus a plan in the assessment supports the diagnosis.

rules.explain: The provider addressed recurrent moderate major depression: F33.1. Severity matters; unspecified recurrent MDD (F33.9) does not map to a V28 HCC.

wrong.why: The condition was addressed at the visit.

rules.explain: COPD appears only in a problem list and is not addressed in this encounter, so it is not supported for this date of service.

wrong.why: A problem-list entry alone does not show the condition affected care at this visit.

rules.explain: Heart failure appears only in a problem list and is not addressed in this encounter, so it is not supported for this date of service.
